      LS_ITEM-VGPOS       = LS_DATA-VGPOS.

      READ TABLE LT_PARTNER INTO DATA(LS_PARTNER) WITH KEY VGBEL = LS_DATA-VGBEL
                                                           VGPOS = LS_DATA-VGPOS.
      IF LS_PARTNER-KUNAG IS NOT INITIAL.
        LS_ITEM-KUNAG_ITM = LS_PARTNER-KUNAG.
      ELSE.
        LS_ITEM-KUNAG_ITM = LS_DATA-KUNAG.
      ENDIF.
      LS_ITEM-KUNRG_ITM   = LS_DATA-KUNRG.
      LS_ITEM-KUNWE_ITM   = LS_PARTNER-KUNWE.
      LS_ITEM-KUNSB_ITM   = LS_DATA-KUNSB.
      LS_ITEM-KUNZ1_ITM   = LS_DATA-KUNZ1.
      LS_ITEM-KUNZA_ITM   = LS_PARTNER-KUNZA.
      LS_ITEM-KUNZ2_ITM   = LS_PARTNER-KUNZ2.

      SELECT SINGLE VBTYP
        FROM VBAK
       WHERE VBELN = @LS_HEADER-VGBEL
        INTO @LS_ITEM-VBTYP_V.

      " 체크용
      LS_CHK-VBELN_VL = LS_DATA-VBELN_VL.
      LS_CHK-POSNR_VL = LS_DATA-POSNR_VL.

      APPEND : LS_ITEM TO LT_ITEM,
               LS_CHK TO LT_CHK.
      CLEAR : LS_ITEM, LS_DATA, LS_CHK.
    ENDLOOP.

    " 금액
    LOOP AT LT_PRICE INTO DATA(LS_PRICE2) WHERE VBELN = LS_DATA-VBELN_VL
                                            AND POSNR = LS_DATA-POSNR_VL.
      IF LS_PRICE2-KBETR IS NOT INITIAL.
        LS_COND-ITM_NUMBER  = LV_POSNR.
        LS_COND-COND_ST_NO  = LS_PRICE2-STUNR.
        LS_COND-COND_COUNT  = '01'.
        LS_COND-COND_TYPE   = LS_PRICE2-KSCHL.
        LS_COND-COND_VALUE  = LS_PRICE2-KBETR.
        LS_COND-CURRENCY    = LS_PRICE2-WAERS.

        LS_CONDX-ITM_NUMBER = LV_POSNR.
        LS_CONDX-COND_ST_NO = LS_PRICE2-STUNR.
        LS_CONDX-COND_COUNT = '01'.
        LS_CONDX-COND_TYPE  = LS_PRICE2-KSCHL.
        LS_CONDX-UPDATEFLAG = GC_U.
        LS_CONDX-COND_VALUE = ABAP_TRUE.
        LS_CONDX-CURRENCY   = ABAP_TRUE.

        IF LS_PRICE2-KSCHL EQ 'MWST'.
        ELSE.
          APPEND LS_COND TO LT_COND.
          APPEND LS_CONDX TO LT_CONDX.
        ENDIF.
      ENDIF.

      CLEAR : LS_COND, LS_CONDX.
    ENDLOOP.

    CALL FUNCTION 'ZSD_SALESORDER_CREATE '
      EXPORTING
        IS_HEADER     = LS_HEAD                 " [SD] Sales Order header
      IMPORTING
        EV_VBELN      = LV_VBELN                " Sales Document
      TABLES
        IT_ITEM       = LT_ITEM                 " [SD] Sales Order Item
        IT_CONDITION  = LT_COND
        IT_CONDITIONX = LT_CONDX
        ET_RETURN     = LT_RETURN.       " Return

    IF LV_VBELN IS INITIAL.
      " 에러 여부 확인
      DATA(LV_MESSAGE) = ZCL_SD_UTIL=>MESSAGE_TEXT_BUILD( IT_RETURN = LT_RETURN TYPE = GC_E ).

      IF LV_MESSAGE IS INITIAL.
        LV_MESSAGE = ZCL_SD_UTIL=>MESSAGE_TEXT_BUILD( IT_RETURN = LT_RETURN TYPE = GC_A ).
      ENDIF.

      IF LV_MESSAGE IS INITIAL.
        LV_MESSAGE = ZCL_SD_UTIL=>MESSAGE_TEXT_BUILD( IT_RETURN = LT_RETURN TYPE = GC_X ).
      ENDIF.

      IF LV_MESSAGE IS INITIAL.
        LV_MESSAGE = ZCL_SD_UTIL=>MESSAGE_TEXT_BUILD( IT_RETURN = LT_RETURN TYPE = GC_I ).
      ENDIF.

      LS_DATA-ICON = ICON_RED_LIGHT.
      LS_DATA-MSG = LV_MESSAGE.

      MODIFY GT_DATA2 FROM LS_DATA TRANSPORTING ICON MSG
                                          WHERE KUNSB = LS_HEADER-KUNSB
                                            AND WAERK = LS_HEADER-WAERK.

    ELSE.
      LS_DATA-ICON  = ICON_GREEN_LIGHT.
      LS_DATA-VBELN = LV_VBELN.
      LV_MESSAGE = ZCL_SD_UTIL=>MESSAGE_TEXT_BUILD( IT_RETURN = LT_RETURN TYPE = GC_S ).

      LOOP AT LT_DATA2 INTO LS_DATA WHERE KUNSB = LS_HEADER-KUNSB
                                      AND WAERK = LS_HEADER-WAERK.
        " CBO 저장용
        CASE C_03.
          WHEN ABAP_TRUE.
            READ TABLE GT_KMC INTO DATA(LS_KMC) WITH KEY FVINNO = LS_DATA-FVINNO.
            IF SY-SUBRC EQ 0.
              MOVE-CORRESPONDING LS_KMC TO LS_SAVE.
              LS_SAVE-ERDAT = SY-DATUM.
              LS_SAVE-ERZET = SY-UZEIT.
              LS_SAVE-ERNAM = SY-UNAME.

              APPEND LS_SAVE TO LT_SAVE.
            ENDIF.

            CLEAR : LS_SAVE, LS_KMC.

          WHEN OTHERS.
            LOOP AT GT_KMC INTO LS_KMC WHERE BSTKD_E = LS_DATA-BSTKD_E.
              MOVE-CORRESPONDING LS_KMC TO LS_SAVE.
              LS_SAVE-ERDAT = SY-DATUM.
              LS_SAVE-ERZET = SY-UZEIT.
              LS_SAVE-ERNAM = SY-UNAME.

              APPEND LS_SAVE TO LT_SAVE.
              CLEAR : LS_KMC, LS_SAVE.
            ENDLOOP.
        ENDCASE.
      ENDLOOP.

      LOOP AT LT_CHK INTO LS_CHK.
        READ TABLE GT_DATA2 INTO LS_DATA WITH KEY VBELN_VL = LS_CHK-VBELN_VL
                                                  POSNR_VL = LS_CHK-POSNR_VL.
        IF SY-SUBRC EQ 0.
          LS_DATA-ICON       = ICON_GREEN_LIGHT.
          LS_DATA-MSG        = LV_MESSAGE.
          LS_DATA-VBELN      = LV_VBELN.

          SELECT SINGLE A~ERDAT,
                 A~ERZET, A~AUART,
                 B~POSNR
            FROM VBAK AS A
            JOIN VBAP AS B  ON B~VBELN = A~VBELN
           WHERE A~VBELN = @LV_VBELN
             AND B~VGBEL = @LS_DATA-VGBEL
             AND B~VGPOS = @LS_DATA-VGPOS
            INTO ( @LS_DATA-ERDAT_SO, @LS_DATA-ERZET_SO,
                   @LS_DATA-AUART, @LS_DATA-POSNR  ).

          MODIFY GT_DATA2 FROM LS_DATA TRANSPORTING ICON MSG VBELN ERDAT_SO ERZET_SO AUART POSNR
                                              WHERE VBELN_VL = LS_DATA-VBELN_VL
                                                AND POSNR_VL = LS_DATA-POSNR_VL.
        ENDIF.
      ENDLOOP.
    ENDIF.

    CLEAR : LS_HEADER, LS_HEAD, LT_ITEM, LT_COND, LT_CONDX, LT_RETURN, LV_POSNR.
  ENDLOOP.

  IF LT_SAVE IS NOT INITIAL.
    MODIFY ZSDT0310 FROM TABLE LT_SAVE.
  ENDIF.

***  DATA : LS_ITEM   TYPE ZSDS0110,                              
***         LT_ITEM   TYPE TABLE OF ZSDS0110,                      &nb
***         LS_COND   TYPE BAPICOND,                         &nbs
***         LT_COND   TYPE TABLE OF BAPICOND,                      &nb
***         LS_CONDX  TYPE BAPICONDX,                          &n
***         LT_CONDX  TYPE TABLE OF BAPICONDX,                       &
***         LS_RETURN TYPE ZSDS0120,                           &n
***         LV_SEQ    TYPE I,                          
***         LV_POSNR  TYPE VBAP-POSNR.                          &
***                                          
***  DATA : LV_KUNSB TYPE VBPA-KUNNR,                               &n
***         LV_WAERK TYPE VBAK-WAERK.                           &
***                                          
***  DATA : LV_ERR,                                    
***         LV_MSG(100).                               
***                                          
***                                          
***  TYPES : BEGIN OF TY_CHK,                                &nbs
***            VBELN_VL TYPE LIPS-VBELN,                        &
***            POSNR_VL TYPE LIPS-POSNR,                        &
***          END OF TY_CHK.                            
***  DATA : LS_CHK TYPE TY_CHK,                                &n
***         LT_CHK TYPE TABLE OF TY_CHK.                         
***                                          
***  RANGES : LR_BSTKD FOR VBKD-BSTKD.                               &
***                                          
***  " 청구일 비어있는지 확인                                   &
***  DATA(LT_FKDAT) = GT_0400.                                  &
***  DELETE LT_FKDAT WHERE FKDAT IS NOT INITIAL.                            
***                                          
***  IF LT_FKDAT IS NOT INITIAL.                                &
***    MESSAGE I000 WITH TEXT-E09.                               
***    EXIT.                                     &
***  ENDIF.                                       
***                                          
***  " 기간 체크                                     &
***  DATA(LT_PERIOD) = GT_0400.                                  
***  SORT LT_PERIOD BY VBELN_VL.                                 
***  DELETE ADJACENT DUPLICATES FROM LT_PERIOD COMPARING VBELN_VL.                         
***  LOOP AT LT_PERIOD INTO DATA(LS_PERIOD).                              &
***    PERFORM PERIOD_CHECK USING LS_PERIOD-FKDAT                            &nb
***                               LS_PERIOD-VBELN_VL        
***                               LV_ERR          
***                               LV_MSG.          
***                                          
***    IF LV_ERR EQ GC_E.                                &nb
***      DATA(LV_PERIOD_CHK) = ABAP_TRUE.                             
***      EXIT.                                   &
***    ENDIF.                                     
***  ENDLOOP.                                      &nbs
***                                          
***  IF LV_PERIOD_CHK EQ ABAP_TRUE.                                &nb
***    MESSAGE I000 WITH LV_MSG.                               &n
***    EXIT.                                     &
***  ENDIF.                                       
***                                          
***  " 납품수량 > 가용수량이면 에러                                 &
***  CLEAR : GS_0400.                                   &nbs
***  LOOP AT GT_0400 INTO GS_0400.                                
***    IF GS_0400-LFIMG > GS_0400-KULAB.                             &nb
***      DATA(LV_AMOUNT) = ABAP_TRUE.                             &nbs
***      EXIT.                                   &
***    ENDIF.                                     
***  ENDLOOP.                                      &nbs
***                                          
***  IF LV_AMOUNT EQ ABAP_TRUE.                                 &
***    MESSAGE I000 WITH TEXT-E17.                               
***    EXIT.                                     &
***  ENDIF.                                       
***                                          
***  SELECT DISTINCT A~VBELN, A~POSNR,                                
***         D~KSCHL, D~KBETR, D~WAERS,                           
***         D~STUNR, D~WAERK                             &nb
***    FROM LIPS AS A                                 &
***    JOIN VBAP AS B  ON B~VBELN = A~VGBEL                         &n
***                   AND B~POSNR = A~POSNR                 
***    JOIN VBAK AS C  ON C~VBELN = B~VBELN                         &n
***    JOIN PRCD_ELEMENTS AS D  ON D~KNUMV = C~KNUMV                        
***                            AND D~KPOSN = B~POSNR        
***                            AND D~KSCHL <> 'ZPR1'       
***                            AND D~KSCHL <> 'ZIS1'       
***    JOIN @GT_0400 AS E  ON E~VBELN_VL = A~VBELN                        &
***                       AND E~POSNR_VL = A~POSNR            &nb
***    INTO TABLE @DATA(LT_PRICE).                                
***                                          
******  " 몇번째인지 확인용                                    
******  CLEAR : GS_0400.                                   &
******  READ TABLE GT_0400 INTO GS_0400 INDEX 1.                            
******  IF SY-SUBRC EQ 0.                                  &
******    DATA(LV_TXT) = GS_0400-FKDAT+(4) && '.' && GS_0400-FKDAT+4(2) && | | && TEXT-M01 && '*'.            
******    DATA(LV_TXT2) = GS_0400-FKDAT+(4) && '.' && GS_0400-FKDAT+4(2) && | | && TEXT-M01.              &nbs
******    __RANGE : LR_BSTKD LV_TXT '' 'CP'.                           &nbs
******                                         &nb
******    SELECT DISTINCT BSTKD, VBELN, POSNR                            &n
******      FROM VBKD                                 &
******     WHERE BSTKD IN @LR_BSTKD                              
******      INTO TABLE @DATA(LT_BSTKD).                             &n
******                                         &nb
******    SORT LT_BSTKD BY BSTKD DESCENDING.                            &nb
******    READ TABLE LT_BSTKD INTO DATA(LS_BSTKD) INDEX 1.                        &nb
******    IF SY-SUBRC EQ 0.                                &
******      DATA(LV_BSTKD) = LS_BSTKD-BSTKD.                            &nb
******      REPLACE LV_TXT2 WITH '' INTO LV_BSTKD.                         
******      CONDENSE LV_BSTKD.                               &nbs
******      LV_SEQ = LV_BSTKD.                               
******    ENDIF.                                    &nb
******  ENDIF.                                      &nb
***                                          
***  LOOP AT GT_0400 INTO DATA(LS_0400) GROUP BY ( KUNSB = LS_0400-KUNSB                    &nb
***                                          
***                                     ASSIGNING FIELD-SYMBOL(&l
***    LOOP AT GROUP <FS_GROUP> ASSIGNING FIELD-SYMBOL(<FS_0400>).                      
***                                          
***      LV_KUNSB = <FS_0400>-KUNSB.                             
***      LV_WAERK = <FS_0400>-WAERK.                             
***                                          
***      " 금액 관련                                 &
***      READ TABLE LT_PRICE INTO DATA(LS_PRICE) WITH KEY VBELN = <FS_0400>-VBELN_VL               
***                                          
***                                          
***      " 메인 데이터                                 
***      READ TABLE GT_DATA2 INTO DATA(LS_DATA2) WITH KEY VBELN_VL = <FS_0400>-VBELN_VL              &nb
***                                          
***      IF SY-SUBRC EQ 0.                              &nbs
***        " 메세지용                                &
***        LS_CHK-VBELN_VL = LS_DATA2-VBELN_VL.                          &n
***        LS_CHK-POSNR_VL = LS_DATA2-POSNR_VL.                          &n
***        APPEND LS_CHK TO LT_CHK.                           &nb
***                                          
***        LV_SEQ += 1.                              &n
***        LV_POSNR += 10.                              
***                                          
***        IF LS_DATA2-VBELN IS NOT INITIAL.                         &
***          LS_ITEM-VBELN = LS_DATA2-VBELN.                         &
***          LS_ITEM-POSNR = LS_DATA2-POSNR.                         &
***        ENDIF.                                 
***                                          
***        LS_ITEM-AUART     = <FS_0400>-AUART.                      
***        LS_ITEM-VKORG     = LS_DATA2-VKORG.                       &
***        LS_ITEM-VTWEG     = LS_DATA2-VTWEG.                       &
***        LS_ITEM-VKBUR     = LS_DATA2-VKBUR.                       &
***        LS_ITEM-VKGRP     = LS_DATA2-VKGRP.                       &
***        LS_ITEM-SPART     = LS_DATA2-SPART.                       &
***        LS_ITEM-BSTKD     = <FS_0400>-FKDAT+(4) && '.' && <FS_0400>-FKDAT+4(2) && | | && TEXT-M01 . "&& LV_SEQ
***        LS_ITEM-KUNAG     = <FS_0400>-KUNRG.                      
***        LS_ITEM-KUNSB     = LS_DATA2-KUNSB.                       &
***        LS_ITEM-VGBEL     = LS_DATA2-VGBEL.                       &
***                                          
***        SELECT SINGLE VBTYP                             &
***          FROM VBAK                             &nbs
***         WHERE VBELN = @LS_DATA2-VGBEL                         &nbs
***          INTO @LS_ITEM-VBTYP_V.                           &nb
***                                          
***        LS_ITEM-POSNR     = LV_POSNR.                        &
***        LS_ITEM-MATNR     = LS_DATA2-MATNR.                       &
***        LS_ITEM-KWMENG    = LS_DATA2-LFIMG.                        
***        LS_ITEM-VRKME     = LS_DATA2-VRKME.                       &
***        LS_ITEM-BSTKD_E   = LS_DATA2-BSTKD_E.                        &nb
***        LS_ITEM-POSEX_E   = LS_DATA2-POSEX_E.                        &nb
***        LS_ITEM-IHREZ_E   = LS_DATA2-IHREZ_E.                        &nb
***        LS_ITEM-VGPOS     = LS_DATA2-VGPOS.                       &
***        LS_ITEM-WADAT_IST = <FS_0400>-FKDAT.                         &n
***        LS_ITEM-PRSDT_ITM = LS_DATA2-PRSDT.                          &nb
***        LS_ITEM-BSTDK_E   = LS_DATA2-WADAT_IST.                        &
***        LS_ITEM-MVGR1     = LS_DATA2-MVGR1.                       &
***        LS_ITEM-WAERK     = LS_PRICE-WAERS.                       &
***        LS_ITEM-EDATU     = <FS_0400>-FKDAT.                      
***                                          
***        APPEND LS_ITEM TO LT_ITEM.                           &
***                                          
***        " 금액                                &nb
***        LOOP AT LT_PRICE INTO DATA(LS_PRICE2) WHERE VBELN = LS_DATA2-VBELN_VL                
***                                          
***          IF LS_PRICE2-KBETR IS NOT INITIAL.                       
***            LS_COND-ITM_NUMBER  = LV_POSNR.                      &n
***            LS_COND-COND_ST_NO  = LS_PRICE2-STUNR.                     &
***            LS_COND-COND_COUNT  = '01'.                       
***            LS_COND-COND_TYPE   = LS_PRICE2-KSCHL.                    &n
***            LS_COND-COND_VALUE  = LS_PRICE2-KBETR.                     &
***            IF LS_PRICE2-WAERS IS NOT INITIAL.                     
***              LS_COND-CURRENCY    = LS_PRICE2-WAERS.                 &nb
***                                          
***            ELSE.                             &
***              LS_COND-CURRENCY    = LS_PRICE2-WAERK.                 &nb
***            ENDIF.                             
***                                          
***            LS_CONDX-ITM_NUMBER = LV_POSNR.                       &
***            LS_CONDX-COND_ST_NO = LS_PRICE2-STUNR.                      
***            LS_CONDX-COND_COUNT = '01'.                        
***            LS_CONDX-COND_TYPE  = LS_PRICE2-KSCHL.                     &
***            LS_CONDX-UPDATEFLAG = GC_U.                        
***            LS_CONDX-COND_VALUE = ABAP_TRUE.                       
***            LS_CONDX-CURRENCY   = ABAP_TRUE.                     &n
***                                          
***            IF LS_PRICE2-KSCHL EQ 'MWST'.                      &nbs
***            ELSE.                             &
***              APPEND LS_COND TO LT_COND.                     &
***              APPEND LS_CONDX TO LT_CONDX.                     
***            ENDIF.                             
***          ENDIF.                               
***                                          
***          CLEAR : LS_PRICE2, LS_COND, LS_CONDX.                      &nb
***        ENDLOOP.                                &nbs
***      ENDIF.                                   
***                                          
***      CLEAR : LS_DATA2, LS_PRICE, LS_CHK.                           
***    ENDLOOP.                                    &nbs
***                                          
***    CALL FUNCTION 'ZSD_SD_ALL_PROCESS'                              &nbs
***      EXPORTING                                  &nb
***        IV_CHK        = ABAP_TRUE                      &n
***      IMPORTING                                  &nb
***        ES_RETURN     = LS_RETURN                 " [SD] 일괄처리 return  &n
***      TABLES                                   
***        IT_DATA       = LT_ITEM                 " [SD] 일괄처리 input &
***        IT_CONDITION  = LT_COND                 " 오더의 조건 유지보수를 위한 통신필드   
***        IT_CONDITIONX = LT_CONDX.                 " 오더의 조건 유지보수를 위한 통신필드   &n
***                                          
***    IF LS_RETURN-VBELN_VF_CHK EQ GC_S.                              
***      LOOP AT LT_CHK INTO LS_CHK.                            &
***        READ TABLE GT_DATA2 INTO LS_DATA2 WITH KEY VBELN_VL = LS_CHK-VBELN_VL               
***                                          
***        IF SY-SUBRC EQ 0.                            &nbs
***          LS_DATA2-ICON       = ICON_GREEN_LIGHT.                   
***          LS_DATA2-MSG        = LS_RETURN-MESSAGE.                  
***          LS_DATA2-VBELN      = LS_RETURN-VBELN.                    
***          LS_DATA2-VBELN_VL2  = LS_RETURN-VBELN_VL.                      &nbs
***          LS_DATA2-VBELN_VF   = LS_RETURN-VBELN_VF.                      
***                                          
***          SELECT SINGLE A~ERDAT,                          &nbs
***                 A~ERZET, A~AUART,                     &n
***                 B~POSNR,                       &nbs
***                 D~FKDAT,                       &nbs
***                 F~WBSTK                        
***            FROM VBAK AS A                         &
***            JOIN VBAP AS B  ON B~VBELN = A~VBELN                 &n
***            LEFT JOIN ( VBRP AS C JOIN VBRK AS D  ON D~VBELN = C~VBELN        &nbs
***                                          
***                                          
***                                          
***                                          
***            LEFT JOIN ( LIPS AS E JOIN LIKP AS F  ON F~VBELN = E~VBELN )       &nb
***                                          
***                                          
***           WHERE A~VBELN = @LS_RETURN-VBELN                       &
***             AND B~VGBEL = @LS_DATA2-VGBEL                     &nbs
***             AND B~VGPOS = @LS_DATA2-VGPOS                     &nbs
***            INTO ( @LS_DATA2-ERDAT_SO, @LS_DATA2-ERZET_SO,                    
***                   @LS_DATA2-AUART, @LS_DATA2-POSNR, @LS_DATA2-FKDAT,             
***                   @LS_DATA2-WBSTK2  ).                  
***                                          
***          MODIFY GT_DATA2 FROM LS_DATA2 TRANSPORTING ICON MSG VBELN VBELN_VL2 VBELN_VF            
***                                          
***                                          
***                                          
***        ENDIF.                                 
***      ENDLOOP.                                  &nbs
***                                          
***    ELSE.                                     &
***      LOOP AT LT_CHK INTO LS_CHK.                            &
***        READ TABLE GT_DATA2 INTO LS_DATA2 WITH KEY VBELN_VL = LS_CHK-VBELN_VL               
***                                          
***        IF SY-SUBRC EQ 0.                            &nbs
***          LS_DATA2-ICON       = ICON_RED_LIGHT.                   &
***          LS_DATA2-MSG        = LS_RETURN-MESSAGE.                  
***                                          
***          MODIFY GT_DATA2 FROM LS_DATA2 TRANSPORTING ICON MSG                  &nb
***                                          
***                                          
***        ENDIF.                                 
***      ENDLOOP.                                  &nbs
***    ENDIF.                                     
***                                          
***                                          
***    CLEAR : LS_DATA2, LV_KUNSB, LV_WAERK, LT_CHK, LT_ITEM, LS_RETURN, LT_COND, LT_CONDX.                &nb
***  ENDLOOP.                                      &nbs
***                                          
***  PERFORM SET_REFRESH USING GO_GRID2                                
***                            GS_LAYO2.            &nb

  LEAVE TO SCREEN 0.

ENDFORM.
*&---------------------------------------------------------------------*                              &nb
*& Form KMC_UPLOAD                                      
*&---------------------------------------------------------------------*                              &nb
*& text                                        &nb
*&---------------------------------------------------------------------*                              &nb
*& -->  p1        text                             &
*& <--  p2        text                             &
*&---------------------------------------------------------------------*                              &nb
FORM KMC_UPLOAD .

  DATA : LV_COUNT TYPE I,
         LS_VIN   TYPE TY_VIN,
         LS_DATA2 TYPE TY_DATA2,
         LV_SUBRC TYPE SY-SUBRC,
         LS_KMC   TYPE TY_KMC.

  CLEAR : GV_FILE, LS_VIN, LS_DATA2, GT_KMC, GT_UPLOAD.

  " VIN EXCEL 초기화
  IF C_03 EQ ABAP_TRUE.
    MODIFY GT_DATA2 FROM LS_DATA2 TRANSPORTING BSTKD_E_EXCEL VIN_NO_EXCEL WHERE BSTKD_E IS NOT INITIAL.
  ELSE.
    MODIFY GT_VIN FROM LS_VIN TRANSPORTING FVINNO WHERE FVINNO IS NOT INITIAL.
    MODIFY GT_DATA2 FROM LS_DATA2 TRANSPORTING BSTKD_E_EXCEL FVINNO_EXCEL WHERE BSTKD_E IS NOT INITIAL.
  ENDIF.

  LV_SUBRC = 0.

  PERFORM FILE_OPEN_DIALOG_RTN USING GV_FILE
                                     LV_SUBRC.

  IF LV_SUBRC EQ 0.
    PERFORM UPLOAD_EXCEL USING GV_FILE '6' LV_SUBRC.

    " 파일값에서 필요한 부분만 옮겨오기
    LOOP AT GT_UPLOAD INTO DATA(LS_UPLOAD).
      IF LS_UPLOAD-STATUS CS 'At Sea'
        OR LS_UPLOAD-STATUS CS 'Dealer Stock'
        OR LS_UPLOAD-STATUS CS 'Dist Stock'.

        CONDENSE : LS_UPLOAD-FVINNO NO-GAPS,
                   LS_UPLOAD-PPLAN NO-GAPS.

        MOVE-CORRESPONDING LS_UPLOAD TO LS_KMC.

        LS_KMC-BSTKD_E = LS_UPLOAD-PPLAN+(13).

        APPEND LS_KMC TO GT_KMC.
      ENDIF.
      CLEAR : LS_KMC, LS_UPLOAD.
    ENDLOOP.

    DATA(LT_CHK) = GT_DATA2.
    DELETE LT_CHK WHERE ICON <> '@08@'.

    " 완료건 포함되었나 확인
    LOOP AT LT_CHK INTO DATA(LS_CHK).
      READ TABLE GT_KMC INTO LS_KMC WITH KEY BSTKD_E = LS_CHK-BSTKD_E.
      IF SY-SUBRC EQ 0.
        DATA(LV_CHK) = ABAP_TRUE.

        LS_CHK-MSG = TEXT-E06.

        MODIFY GT_DATA2 FROM LS_CHK TRANSPORTING MSG
                                    WHERE BSTKD_E = LS_CHK-BSTKD_E.
      ENDIF.

      CLEAR : LS_CHK, LS_KMC.
    ENDLOOP.

    IF LV_CHK EQ ABAP_TRUE.
      MESSAGE I000 WITH TEXT-E06.
      EXIT.
    ENDIF.

    LOOP AT GT_KMC INTO LS_KMC.
*      " 일치하는 W/Order 찾기                               
*      READ TABLE GT_DATA2 INTO DATA(LS_DATA) WITH KEY BSTKD_E = LS_UPLOAD-BSTKD_E.                &
*      IF SY-SUBRC EQ 0.   " 일치하면 넣어주기                        &nb
*        LS_DATA-BSTKD_E_EXCEL = LS_UPLOAD-BSTKD_E.                         &nbs
*                                          &n
*        MODIFY GT_DATA2 FROM LS_DATA TRANSPORTING BSTKD_E_EXCEL WHERE BSTKD_E = LS_DATA-BSTKD_E.            &
*      ENDIF.                                   &n

      " 일치하는 VIN NO 찾기
      IF C_03 EQ ABAP_TRUE.
        READ TABLE GT_DATA2 INTO LS_DATA2 WITH KEY FULL_VIN_NO = LS_KMC-FVINNO
                                                   BSTKD_E     = LS_KMC-BSTKD_E.
        IF SY-SUBRC EQ 0.
          LS_DATA2-VIN_NO_EXCEL  = LS_KMC-FVINNO.
          LS_DATA2-BSTKD_E_EXCEL = LS_KMC-BSTKD_E.
          LS_DATA2-ZZPRD_DATE    = LS_KMC-ZZPRD_DATE.
          LS_DATA2-ZZSHIP_DATE   = LS_KMC-ZZSHIP_DATE.
          LS_DATA2-ZZETA         = LS_KMC-ZZETA.
          MODIFY GT_DATA2 FROM LS_DATA2 TRANSPORTING VIN_NO_EXCEL BSTKD_E_EXCEL ZZPRD_DATE ZZSHIP_DATE ZZETA
                                               WHERE FULL_VIN_NO = LS_DATA2-FULL_VIN_NO
                                                 AND BSTKD_E     = LS_KMC-BSTKD_E.
        ENDIF.

      ELSE.
        READ TABLE GT_VIN INTO LS_VIN WITH KEY FULL_VIN_NO   = LS_KMC-FVINNO
                                               WORDER_NO     = LS_KMC-BSTKD_E.
        IF SY-SUBRC EQ 0.
          LS_VIN-FVINNO         = LS_KMC-FVINNO.
          LS_VIN-ZZPRD_DATE     = LS_KMC-ZZPRD_DATE.
          LS_VIN-ZZSHIP_DATE    = LS_KMC-ZZSHIP_DATE.
          LS_VIN-ZZETA          = LS_KMC-ZZETA.

          MODIFY GT_VIN FROM LS_VIN TRANSPORTING FVINNO ZZPRD_DATE ZZSHIP_DATE ZZETA
                                    WHERE FULL_VIN_NO = LS_KMC-FVINNO.

          READ TABLE GT_DATA2 INTO DATA(LS_DATA) WITH KEY BSTKD_E = LS_KMC-BSTKD_E.
          IF SY-SUBRC EQ 0.
            LS_DATA-BSTKD_E_EXCEL = LS_KMC-BSTKD_E.

            MODIFY GT_DATA2 FROM LS_DATA TRANSPORTING BSTKD_E_EXCEL
                                         WHERE BSTKD_E = LS_KMC-BSTKD_E.
          ENDIF.
        ENDIF.
      ENDIF.

      CLEAR : LS_UPLOAD, LS_DATA, LS_DATA2, LS_VIN.
    ENDLOOP.
  ENDIF.

  IF GT_KMC IS NOT INITIAL.
    " VIN EXCEL 개수 넣기
    CLEAR : LS_VIN, LS_DATA2.
    IF C_03 NE ABAP_TRUE.
      LOOP AT GT_VIN INTO LS_VIN GROUP BY ( WORDER_NO = LS_VIN-WORDER_NO
                                            VBELN_VL  = LS_VIN-VBELN_VL
                                            POSNR_VL  = LS_VIN-POSNR_VL )
                                       ASSIGNING FIELD-SYMBOL(<FS_GROUP>).

        CLEAR : LV_COUNT.

        LOOP AT GROUP <FS_GROUP> ASSIGNING FIELD-SYMBOL(<FS_DATA>).
          READ TABLE GT_DATA2 INTO LS_DATA2 WITH KEY VBELN_VL = <FS_DATA>-VBELN_VL
                                                     POSNR_VL = <FS_DATA>-POSNR_VL.
          IF <FS_DATA>-FVINNO IS NOT INITIAL.
            LV_COUNT += 1.
          ENDIF.
        ENDLOOP.

        LS_DATA2-FVINNO_EXCEL = LV_COUNT.
        MODIFY GT_DATA2 FROM LS_DATA2 TRANSPORTING FVINNO_EXCEL WHERE VBELN_VL = LS_DATA2-VBELN_VL
                                                                  AND POSNR_VL = LS_DATA2-POSNR_VL.

        CLEAR : LS_DATA2.
      ENDLOOP.
    ENDIF.

    " 총 W/Oder 개수
    DATA(LT_ORDER) = GT_DATA2.
    SORT LT_ORDER BY BSTKD_E.
    DELETE ADJACENT DUPLICATES FROM LT_ORDER COMPARING BSTKD_E.
    DATA(LV_WORDER) = REDUCE I( INIT X = 0 FOR WA IN LT_ORDER
                       WHERE ( BSTKD_E IS NOT INITIAL ) NEXT X = X + 1 ).

    " 일치하는 W/Order(Excel) 개수
    DATA(LT_ORDER2) = GT_DATA2.
    DELETE LT_ORDER2 WHERE BSTKD_E_EXCEL IS INITIAL.
    SORT LT_ORDER2 BY BSTKD_E_EXCEL.
    DELETE ADJACENT DUPLICATES FROM LT_ORDER2 COMPARING BSTKD_E_EXCEL.
    DATA(LV_EWORDER) = REDUCE I( INIT X = 0 FOR WA2 IN LT_ORDER2
                        WHERE ( BSTKD_E IS NOT INITIAL ) NEXT X = X + 1 ).

    " VIN No 개수
    IF C_03 EQ ABAP_TRUE.
      DATA(LT_VIN) = GT_DATA2.
      SORT LT_VIN BY FULL_VIN_NO.
      DELETE ADJACENT DUPLICATES FROM LT_VIN COMPARING FULL_VIN_NO.
      DATA(LV_VIN) = REDUCE I( INIT X = 0 FOR WA3 IN LT_VIN
                      WHERE ( FULL_VIN_NO IS NOT INITIAL ) NEXT X = X + 1 ).

    ELSE.
      DATA(LT_VIN2) = GT_VIN.
      SORT LT_VIN2 BY VIN_NO.
      DELETE ADJACENT DUPLICATES FROM LT_VIN COMPARING FULL_VIN_NO.
      LV_VIN = REDUCE I( INIT X = 0 FOR WA4 IN LT_VIN2
                WHERE ( VIN_NO IS NOT INITIAL ) NEXT X = X + 1 ).
    ENDIF.

    " VIN No(Excel) 개수
    IF C_03 EQ ABAP_TRUE.
      DATA(LT_VIN_EXCEL2) = GT_DATA2.
      DELETE LT_VIN_EXCEL2 WHERE VIN_NO_EXCEL IS INITIAL.
      SORT LT_VIN_EXCEL2 BY VIN_NO_EXCEL.
      DELETE ADJACENT DUPLICATES FROM LT_VIN_EXCEL2 COMPARING VIN_NO_EXCEL.

      DATA(LV_EVIN) = REDUCE I( INIT X = 0 FOR WA5 IN LT_VIN_EXCEL2
                      WHERE ( VIN_NO_EXCEL IS NOT INITIAL ) NEXT X = X + 1 ).

    ELSE.
      DATA(LT_VIN_EXCEL) = GT_VIN.
      DELETE LT_VIN_EXCEL WHERE FVINNO IS INITIAL.
      SORT LT_VIN_EXCEL BY FVINNO.
      DELETE ADJACENT DUPLICATES FROM LT_VIN_EXCEL COMPARING FVINNO.

      LV_EVIN = REDUCE I( INIT X = 0 FOR WA6 IN LT_VIN_EXCEL
                WHERE ( FVINNO IS NOT INITIAL ) NEXT X = X + 1 ).
    ENDIF.

    DATA(LV_TEXT)  = TEXT-M02 && | | && LV_WORDER && | | && TEXT-M06 && | |
                     && '/' && TEXT-M03 && | | && LV_EWORDER && TEXT-M06.
    DATA(LV_TEXT2) = TEXT-M04 && | | && LV_VIN && | | && TEXT-M06 && | |
                     && '/' && TEXT-M05 && | | && LV_EVIN && TEXT-M06.

    CALL FUNCTION 'POPUP_TO_DISPLAY_TEXT'
      EXPORTING
*       TITEL     = SPACE                           &nb
        TEXTLINE1 = LV_TEXT
        TEXTLINE2 = LV_TEXT2
*       START_COLUMN = 25                               
*       START_ROW = 6                               &nb
      .
    .
    IF SY-SUBRC <> 0.
* MESSAGE ID SY-MSGID TYPE SY-MSGTY NUMBER SY-MSGNO                            &
*   WITH SY-MSGV1 SY-MSGV2 SY-MSGV3 SY-MSGV4.                             &
    ENDIF.

  ELSE.
    IF LV_SUBRC EQ 0.
      MESSAGE I000 WITH TEXT-E14.
      EXIT.
    ENDIF.
  ENDIF.

  PERFORM SET_REFRESH USING GO_GRID2
                            GS_LAYO2.

ENDFORM.
*&---------------------------------------------------------------------*                              &nb
*& Form FILE_OPEN_DIALOG_RTN                                    &
*&---------------------------------------------------------------------*                              &nb
*& text                                        &nb
*&---------------------------------------------------------------------*                              &nb
*&      --> GV_FILE                                 
*&---------------------------------------------------------------------*                              &nb
FORM FILE_OPEN_DIALOG_RTN  USING    PV_VAL
                                    PV_SUBRC.

  DATA: LT_FILEPATH TYPE FILETABLE,
        LV_RETURN   TYPE I,
        LV_DIR      TYPE STRING.


  LV_DIR    = PV_VAL.
  GV_FILTER = GV_ALL.

  CL_GUI_FRONTEND_SERVICES=>FILE_OPEN_DIALOG(
      EXPORTING
      WINDOW_TITLE            = 'File Open'
      FILE_FILTER             = GV_FILTER
      INITIAL_DIRECTORY       = LV_DIR
    CHANGING
      FILE_TABLE              = LT_FILEPATH
      RC                      = LV_RETURN
    EXCEPTIONS
      FILE_OPEN_DIALOG_FAILED = 1
      CNTL_ERROR              = 2
      ERROR_NO_GUI            = 3
      NOT_SUPPORTED_BY_GUI    = 4 ).

  IF SY-SUBRC <> 0.
    PV_SUBRC = SY-SUBRC.
    MESSAGE ID SY-MSGID TYPE GC_I NUMBER SY-MSGNO
               WITH SY-MSGV1 SY-MSGV2 SY-MSGV3 SY-MSGV4.
  ENDIF.

  IF LV_RETURN  = 1.
    READ TABLE LT_FILEPATH INTO PV_VAL INDEX 1.
  ENDIF.


ENDFORM.
*&---------------------------------------------------------------------*                              &nb
*& Form UPLOAD_EXCEL                                     &nb
*&---------------------------------------------------------------------*                              &nb
*& text                                        &nb
*&---------------------------------------------------------------------*                              &nb
*&      --> GV_FILE                                 
*&      --> P_                                  
*&---------------------------------------------------------------------*                              &nb
FORM UPLOAD_EXCEL  USING PV_FILE  PV_ROW PV_SUBRC.

  " 장착계약 업로드
  DATA : LV_TABIX  TYPE SY-TABIX.
  DATA : LV_STRING TYPE STRING.

  DATA : LS_UPLOAD  TYPE TY_UPLOAD.

  FIELD-SYMBOLS <FS>.

  CLEAR : GV_ERR, LV_TABIX.

  __PROGRESS : 10 'Data Uploading...'.
  __CLEAR    : GT_EXCEL.

  CALL FUNCTION 'ALSM_EXCEL_TO_INTERNAL_TABLE'
    EXPORTING
      FILENAME                = PV_FILE
      I_BEGIN_COL             = 1
      I_BEGIN_ROW             = PV_ROW
      I_END_COL               = 256
      I_END_ROW               = 65536
    TABLES
      INTERN                  = GT_EXCEL
    EXCEPTIONS
      INCONSISTENT_PARAMETERS = 1
      UPLOAD_OLE              = 2
      OTHERS                  = 3.

  IF SY-SUBRC EQ 0.
    __CLEAR : GT_UPLOAD.

    LOOP AT GT_EXCEL.
      LV_TABIX = GT_EXCEL-COL.

      ASSIGN COMPONENT LV_TABIX OF STRUCTURE LS_UPLOAD TO <FS>.

      TRANSLATE GT_EXCEL-VALUE TO UPPER CASE.

      MOVE GT_EXCEL-VALUE TO <FS>.

      AT END OF ROW.
        APPEND LS_UPLOAD TO GT_UPLOAD. CLEAR : LS_UPLOAD.
      ENDAT.
    ENDLOOP.
  ELSE.
    PV_SUBRC = SY-SUBRC.
  ENDIF.

ENDFORM.
*&---------------------------------------------------------------------*                              &nb
*& Form CALL_VIN_POPUP                                     &
*&---------------------------------------------------------------------*                              &nb
*& text                                        &nb
*&---------------------------------------------------------------------*                              &nb
*&      --> LS_DATA2                                 
*&---------------------------------------------------------------------*                              &nb
FORM CALL_VIN_POPUP  USING    PS_DATA TYPE TY_DATA2
                              PV_CHK.

  TYPES : BEGIN OF TY_VIN_P,
            NO_PDI      TYPE ZSDT0180-NO_PDI,
            NO_LINE     TYPE ZSDT0180-NO_LINE,
            NO_LINE_D   TYPE ZSDT0180-NO_LINE_D,
            WORDER_NO   TYPE ZSDT0180-WORDER_NO,
            VIN_NO      TYPE ZSDT0180-VIN_NO,
            FULL_VIN_NO TYPE ZSDT0180-FULL_VIN_NO,
            SERIAL_NO   TYPE ZSDT0180-SERIAL_NO,
          END OF TY_VIN_P.
  DATA : LT_VIN_P TYPE TABLE OF TY_VIN_P.

  TYPES : BEGIN OF TY_VIN_E,
            NO_PDI      TYPE ZSDT0180-NO_PDI,
            NO_LINE     TYPE ZSDT0180-NO_LINE,
            NO_LINE_D   TYPE ZSDT0180-NO_LINE_D,
            WORDER_NO   TYPE ZSDT0180-WORDER_NO,
            VIN_NO      TYPE ZSDT0180-VIN_NO,
            FULL_VIN_NO TYPE ZSDT0180-FULL_VIN_NO,
            SERIAL_NO   TYPE ZSDT0180-SERIAL_NO,
            FVINNO      TYPE ZSDT0180-VIN_NO,
            ZZPRD_DATE  TYPE VBAP-ZZPRD_DATE,
            ZZSHIP_DATE TYPE VBAP-ZZSHIP_DATE,
            ZZETA       TYPE VBAP-ZZETA,
          END OF TY_VIN_E.
  DATA : LT_VIN_E TYPE TABLE OF TY_VIN_E.

  CASE PV_CHK.
    WHEN GC_V.
      LT_VIN_P = VALUE #( FOR WA IN GT_VIN
                  WHERE ( VBELN_VL = PS_DATA-VBELN_VL
                    AND   POSNR_VL = PS_DATA-POSNR_VL )
                        ( CORRESPONDING #( WA ) ) ).

      SORT LT_VIN_P BY NO_PDI NO_LINE NO_LINE_D.

      CALL METHOD ZCL_SD_UTIL=>SALV_POPUP( IT_TAB = LT_VIN_P ).

    WHEN GC_E.
      LT_VIN_E = VALUE #( FOR WA IN GT_VIN
                  WHERE ( VBELN_VL = PS_DATA-VBELN_VL
                    AND   POSNR_VL = PS_DATA-POSNR_VL )
                        ( CORRESPONDING #( WA ) ) ).

      SORT LT_VIN_E BY NO_PDI NO_LINE NO_LINE_D.

      CALL METHOD ZCL_SD_UTIL=>SALV_POPUP( IT_TAB = LT_VIN_E ).
  ENDCASE.


ENDFORM.
*&---------------------------------------------------------------------*                              &nb
*& Form MES                                       
*&---------------------------------------------------------------------*                              &nb
*& text                                        &nb
*&---------------------------------------------------------------------*                              &nb
*& -->  p1        text                             &
*& <--  p2        text                             &
*&---------------------------------------------------------------------*                              &nb
FORM MES .

  DATA : LS_HEADER TYPE ZSDS0230,
         LS_ITEM   TYPE ZSDS0240,
         LT_ITEM   TYPE TABLE OF ZSDS0240,
         LS_RETURN TYPE ZSDS0250.

  DATA : LV_LGORT TYPE MARD-LGORT.

  DATA : LS_DATA2 TYPE TY_DATA2,
         LT_ROWS  TYPE LVC_T_ROID.

  CLEAR : LS_DATA2.
  MODIFY GT_DATA2 FROM LS_DATA2 TRANSPORTING CHK WHERE CHK IS NOT INITIAL.

  PERFORM SELECTED_ROWS(ZSDR0000) TABLES LT_ROWS
                                   USING GO_GRID2.

  " 선택한 라인이 없으면 에러
  IF LT_ROWS IS INITIAL.
    MESSAGE I004.
    EXIT.
  ENDIF.

  " 선택 라인 체크
  LOOP AT LT_ROWS INTO DATA(LS_ROWS).
    READ TABLE GT_DATA2 ASSIGNING FIELD-SYMBOL(<FS>) INDEX LS_ROWS-ROW_ID.
    IF <FS> IS ASSIGNED.

      <FS>-CHK = ABAP_TRUE.

      UNASSIGN <FS>.
    ENDIF.
  ENDLOOP.

  " 매출처리 됐는지 확인
  READ TABLE GT_DATA2 INTO LS_DATA2 WITH KEY CHK      = ABAP_TRUE
                                             VBELN_VF = ''.
  IF SY-SUBRC EQ 0.
    MESSAGE I000 WITH TEXT-E20.
    EXIT.
  ENDIF.

  DATA(LT_DATA) = GT_DATA2.
  DELETE LT_DATA WHERE CHK IS INITIAL.
  SORT LT_DATA BY VBELN.
  DELETE ADJACENT DUPLICATES FROM LT_DATA COMPARING VBELN.

  " HEADER
  SELECT DISTINCT B~VBELN, B~VKORG,
         I~VTWEG, B~LFART, B~WADAT_IST,
         B~KUNAG, B~INCO1,
         C~KUNNR AS KUNSB,
         E~NAME1 AS KUNSB_NM,
         E~HOUSE_NUM1, E~STREET,
         E~STR_SUPPL1, E~CITY1,
         F~BEZEI,
         G~BSTKD,
         H~VTEXT
    FROM @LT_DATA AS A
    JOIN LIKP AS B  ON B~VBELN = A~VBELN_VL2
    LEFT JOIN VBPA AS C  ON C~VBELN = B~VBELN
                        AND C~POSNR = '000000'
                        AND C~PARVW = 'SB'
    LEFT JOIN KNA1 AS D ON D~KUNNR = C~KUNNR
    LEFT JOIN ADRC AS E  ON E~ADDRNUMBER = D~ADRNR
    LEFT JOIN T005U AS F  ON F~LAND1 = D~LAND1
                         AND F~SPRAS = @SY-LANGU
                         AND F~BLAND = D~REGIO
    LEFT JOIN VBKD AS G  ON G~VBELN = B~VBELN
    LEFT JOIN TVLKT AS H  ON H~LFART = B~LFART
                         AND H~SPRAS = @SY-LANGU
    JOIN LIPS AS I  ON I~VBELN = B~VBELN
    INTO TABLE @DATA(LT_HEAD).

  SORT LT_HEAD BY VBELN VKORG VTWEG LFART WADAT_IST KUNAG INCO1 KUNSB.
  DELETE ADJACENT DUPLICATES FROM LT_HEAD COMPARING VBELN VKORG VTWEG LFART WADAT_IST KUNAG INCO1 KUNSB.

  " ITEM
  SELECT DISTINCT B~VBELN, B~POSNR,
         B~WERKS, B~MATNR,
         B~LFIMG, B~VRKME
    FROM @LT_HEAD AS A
    JOIN LIPS AS B  ON B~VBELN = A~VBELN
    INTO TABLE @DATA(LT_LIPS).

  SELECT DISTINCT FIELD05 AS LGORT,
         FIELD09 AS KUNSB
    FROM ZCMT0030
   WHERE ZMODULE = 'SD'
     AND CLASS   = 'SD010'
    INTO TABLE @DATA(LT_0030).


  LOOP AT LT_HEAD INTO DATA(LS_HEAD).

    SELECT SINGLE FIELD06
      FROM ZCMT0030
     WHERE ZMODULE = 'SD'
       AND CLASS   = 'SD004'
       AND FIELD05 = @LS_HEAD-INCO1
      INTO @LV_LGORT.

    LS_HEADER-IF_TYPE   = GC_I.
    LS_HEADER-VBELN_VL  = LS_HEAD-VBELN.
    LS_HEADER-VKORG     = LS_HEAD-VKORG.
    LS_HEADER-VTWEG     = LS_HEAD-VTWEG.
    LS_HEADER-LFART     = LS_HEAD-LFART.
    LS_HEADER-VTEXT     = LS_HEAD-VTEXT.
    LS_HEADER-GI_TYPE   = 'GI'.
    LS_HEADER-WADAT_IST = LS_HEAD-WADAT_IST.
    LS_HEADER-KUNAG     = LS_HEAD-KUNAG.
    LS_HEADER-KUNWE     = LS_HEAD-KUNSB.
    LS_HEADER-KUNWE_NM  = LS_HEAD-KUNSB_NM.
    LS_HEADER-ADDRESS   = LS_HEAD-HOUSE_NUM1 && | | && LS_HEAD-STREET && | | &&
                          LS_HEAD-STR_SUPPL1 && | | && LS_HEAD-CITY1 && | | &&
                          LS_HEAD-BEZEI.
    LS_HEADER-INCO1     = LS_HEAD-INCO1.
    LS_HEADER-BSTKD     = LS_HEAD-BSTKD.

    LOOP AT LT_LIPS INTO DATA(LS_LIPS) WHERE VBELN = LS_HEAD-VBELN.
      LS_ITEM-VBELN_VL  = LS_LIPS-VBELN.
      LS_ITEM-POSNR_VL  = LS_LIPS-POSNR.
      LS_ITEM-WERKS_D   = LS_LIPS-WERKS.
***      LS_ITEM-LGORT_F   = LS_LIPS-LGORT.                           

      READ TABLE LT_0030 INTO DATA(LS_0030) WITH KEY KUNSB = |{ LS_HEAD-KUNSB ALPHA = OUT }|.
      IF SY-SUBRC EQ 0.
        LS_ITEM-LGORT_F = LS_0030-LGORT.
      ENDIF.
      LS_ITEM-MATNR     = LS_LIPS-MATNR.
      LS_ITEM-LFIMG     = LS_LIPS-LFIMG.
      LS_ITEM-VRKME     = LS_LIPS-VRKME.

      APPEND LS_ITEM TO LT_ITEM.
      CLEAR : LS_ITEM, LS_LIPS.
    ENDLOOP.

    CALL FUNCTION 'ZSD_IF_MES_SEND '
      EXPORTING
        IS_HEADER = LS_HEADER                " [SD] SD0090 MES 송신 펑션 Header
        IV_ID     = 'SD0090'
      IMPORTING
        ES_RETURN = LS_RETURN
      TABLES
        IT_ITEM   = LT_ITEM.                 " [SD] SD0090 MES 송신 펑션 Item

    CASE LS_RETURN-TYPE.
      WHEN GC_S.    " 송신 성공했으면
        PERFORM CHANGE_STATUS USING LS_HEAD-VBELN.

***        SELECT SINGLE ZZSTATUS_MES_GI                           &nb
***          FROM LIPS                             &nbs
***         WHERE VBELN = @LS_HEAD-VBELN                          
***          INTO @LS_DATA2-ZZSTATUS_MES_GI.                          

        SELECT SINGLE ZZSTATUS_MES_GI
          FROM ZSDT0340
         WHERE VBELN = @LS_HEAD-VBELN
          INTO @LS_DATA2-ZZSTATUS_MES_GI.

        LS_DATA2-MSG  = LS_RETURN-MESSAGE.
        LS_DATA2-ICON = ICON_GREEN_LIGHT.

        MODIFY GT_DATA2 FROM LS_DATA2 TRANSPORTING ZZSTATUS_MES_GI MSG ICON WHERE VBELN_VL2 = LS_HEAD-VBELN.

        CLEAR : LS_DATA2.

      WHEN OTHERS.
        LS_DATA2-MSG  = LS_RETURN-MESSAGE.
        LS_DATA2-ICON = ICON_RED_LIGHT.

        MODIFY GT_DATA2 FROM LS_DATA2 TRANSPORTING MSG ICON WHERE VBELN_VL2 = LS_HEAD-VBELN.
    ENDCASE.

    CLEAR : LS_HEADER, LS_HEAD.
  ENDLOOP.




ENDFORM.
*&---------------------------------------------------------------------*                              &nb
*& Form CHANGE_STATUS                                     &n
*&---------------------------------------------------------------------*                              &nb
*& text                                        &nb
*&---------------------------------------------------------------------*                              &nb
*&      --> LS_HEAD                                 
*&---------------------------------------------------------------------*                              &nb
FORM CHANGE_STATUS  USING    PV_VBELN.

  DATA : LS_SAVE TYPE ZSDT0340,
         LT_SAVE TYPE TABLE OF ZSDT0340.

  SELECT DISTINCT VBELN, POSNR, WERKS
    FROM LIPS
   WHERE VBELN = @PV_VBELN
    INTO TABLE @DATA(LT_LIPS).

  LS_SAVE-ERDAT           = SY-DATUM.
  LS_SAVE-ERZET           = SY-UZEIT.
  LS_SAVE-ERNAM           = SY-UNAME.
  LS_SAVE-ZZSTATUS_MES_GI = GC_S.

  LOOP AT LT_LIPS INTO DATA(LS_LIPS).
    MOVE-CORRESPONDING LS_LIPS TO LS_SAVE.

    APPEND LS_SAVE TO LT_SAVE.

    CLEAR : LS_SAVE-VBELN, LS_SAVE-POSNR, LS_LIPS.
  ENDLOOP.

  IF LT_SAVE IS NOT INITIAL.
    MODIFY ZSDT0340 FROM TABLE LT_SAVE.
    COMMIT WORK.
  ENDIF.

  " 안되는거 잊어버리고 해놓았어서 CBO 저장으로 변경
***  " 납품문서 변경용                                    &nbs
***  DATA : LV_VBELN  TYPE LIKP-VBELN,                              &n
***         LS_RETURN TYPE ZSDS0220,                           &n
***         LS_ITEM   TYPE ZSDS0210,                         &nbs
***         LT_ITEM   TYPE TABLE OF ZSDS0210.                      &nb
***                                          
***  LV_VBELN = PV_VBELN.                                   
***                                          
***  CALL FUNCTION 'ENQUEUE_EVVBLKE'                                 &
***    EXPORTING                                    &nb
***      MODE_LIKP      = GC_E                          &nbs
***      MANDT          = SY-MANDT                      &nbs
***      VBELN          = LV_VBELN                      &nbs
***    EXCEPTIONS                                    &n
***      FOREIGN_LOCK   = 1                             &nbs
***      SYSTEM_FAILURE = 2                               &n
***      OTHERS         = 3.                        &nb
***                                          
***  SELECT DISTINCT VBELN,POSNR                                  
***    FROM LIPS                                   &nbs
***   WHERE VBELN = @LV_VBELN                                &nbs
***    INTO TABLE @DATA(LT_LIPS).                                
***                                          
***  LOOP AT LT_LIPS INTO DATA(LS_LIPS).                               
***    " 아이템                                    &n
***    LS_ITEM-VBELN            = LS_LIPS-VBELN.                    &n
***    LS_ITEM-POSNR            = LS_LIPS-POSNR.                    &n
***    LS_ITEM-ZZSTATUS_MES_GI  = GC_S.                              &
***                                          
***    APPEND LS_ITEM TO LT_ITEM.                               &
***  ENDLOOP.                                      &nbs
***                                          
***  CALL FUNCTION 'ZSD_DELIVERYORDER_CHANGE'                               &nbs
***    EXPORTING                                    &nb
***      IV_VBELN  = LV_VBELN                " 납품            &nbs
***    IMPORTING                                    &nb
***      ES_RETURN = LS_RETURN                " [SD] Delivery Order Change Return     
***    TABLES                                     
***      IT_ITEM   = LT_ITEM.        " [SD] Delivery Order Change input           &nb
***                                          
***  IF LS_RETURN-TYPE = GC_S.                                 &n
***    CALL FUNCTION 'DEQUEUE_EVVBLKE'                               &
***      EXPORTING                                  &nb
***        MODE_LIKP = GC_E                             &nbs
***        MANDT     = SY-MANDT                         &nbs
***        VBELN     = LV_VBELN.                         &nb
***  ENDIF.                                       



ENDFORM.
*&---------------------------------------------------------------------*                              &nb
*& Form INVOICE                                      &n
*&---------------------------------------------------------------------*                              &nb
*& text                                        &nb
*&---------------------------------------------------------------------*                              &nb
*& -->  p1        text                             &
*& <--  p2        text                             &
*&---------------------------------------------------------------------*                              &nb
FORM INVOICE .

  DATA : LS_HEAD  TYPE TY_EXCEL_HEAD,
         LS_ITEM  TYPE TY_EXCEL_ITEM,
         LV_VBELN TYPE VBRP-VBELN,
         LV_MVGR1 TYPE VBRP-MVGR1,
         LV_COUNT TYPE I,
         LV_NUM   TYPE P LENGTH 8 DECIMALS 2.

  DATA : LV_NETPR  TYPE NETPR,
         LV_NETPR2 TYPE NETPR.

  DATA : LV_SUBRC TYPE SY-SUBRC.

  DATA : LS_DATA2 TYPE TY_DATA2,
         LT_ROWS  TYPE LVC_T_ROID.

  CLEAR : LS_DATA2.
  MODIFY GT_DATA2 FROM LS_DATA2 TRANSPORTING CHK WHERE CHK IS NOT INITIAL.

  PERFORM SELECTED_ROWS(ZSDR0000) TABLES LT_ROWS
                                   USING GO_GRID2.

  " 선택한 라인이 없으면 에러
  IF LT_ROWS IS INITIAL.
    MESSAGE I004.
    EXIT.
  ENDIF.

  " 선택 라인 체크
  LOOP AT LT_ROWS INTO DATA(LS_ROWS).
    READ TABLE GT_DATA2 ASSIGNING FIELD-SYMBOL(<FS>) INDEX LS_ROWS-ROW_ID.
    IF <FS> IS ASSIGNED.

      <FS>-CHK = ABAP_TRUE.

      UNASSIGN <FS>.
    ENDIF.
  ENDLOOP.

  " 판매오더 2건 이상 선택됐는지 확인
  DATA(LT_VBELN) = GT_DATA2.
  DELETE LT_VBELN WHERE CHK IS INITIAL.
  SORT LT_VBELN BY VGBEL.
  DELETE ADJACENT DUPLICATES FROM LT_VBELN COMPARING VGBEL.

  IF LINES( LT_VBELN ) > 1.
    MESSAGE I000 WITH TEXT-E08.
    EXIT.
  ENDIF.

  " 판매오더 존재하는지 확인
  READ TABLE GT_DATA2 INTO LS_DATA2 WITH KEY CHK   = ABAP_TRUE
                                             VGBEL = ''.
  IF SY-SUBRC EQ 0.
    MESSAGE I000 WITH TEXT-E04.
    EXIT.
  ENDIF.

***  " 납품문서 존재하는지 확인                                   
***  read table gt_data2 into ls_data2 with key chk       = abap_true                 
***                                          
***  if sy-subrc eq 0.                                  &nbs
***    message i000 with text-e05.                               
***    exit.                                     &
***  endif.                                       
***                                          
***  " billing 문서 존재하는지 확인                                 &
***  read table gt_data2 into ls_data2 with key chk      = abap_true                  
***                                          
***  if sy-subrc eq 0.                                  &nbs
***    message i000 with text-e06.                               
***    exit.                                     &
***  endif.                                       
***                                          
***  " mes 송신 여부 확인                                  &n
***  read table gt_data2 into ls_data2 with key chk             = abap_true           
***                                          
***  if sy-subrc eq 0.                                  &nbs
***    message i000 with text-e07.                               
***    exit.                                     &
***  endif.                                       

  " MAIN
  CLEAR : LS_DATA2.
  READ TABLE GT_DATA2 INTO LS_DATA2 WITH KEY CHK = ABAP_TRUE.
  IF SY-SUBRC EQ 0.
    LV_VBELN = LS_DATA2-VGBEL.
  ENDIF.

  " Header 주소( Beneficiary )
  CLEAR : GS_EXCEL_HEAD, GT_EXCEL_ITEM.
  SELECT SINGLE B~NAME1, B~STREET, B~STR_SUPPL1,
         B~CITY1, B~POST_CODE1, B~NAME2
    FROM J_1BBRANCH AS A
    JOIN ADRC AS B  ON B~ADDRNUMBER = A~ADRNR
   WHERE A~BUKRS  = '1000'
     AND A~BRANCH = 'Z144'
    INTO @DATA(LS_ADRC).

  " Header 주소( APPLICANT )
  SELECT SINGLE
         A~WAERK, A~VDATU,
         D~NAME1, D~NAME2,
         D~STREET, D~CITY1, D~POST_CODE1,
         E~INCO1, E~INCO2,
         CASE
         WHEN E~KURRF IS INITIAL
           OR E~KURRF IS NULL
           OR E~KURRF EQ 0
         THEN E~KURSK
         ELSE E~KURRF
          END AS KURRF,
         F~VTEXT
    FROM VBAK AS A
    JOIN VBAP AS B  ON B~VBELN = A~VBELN
    JOIN ( KNA1 AS C JOIN ADRC AS D  ON D~ADDRNUMBER = C~ADRNR )
                                     ON C~KUNNR = A~KUNNR
    LEFT JOIN ( VBKD AS E LEFT JOIN TVZBT AS F  ON F~ZTERM = E~ZTERM
                                               AND F~SPRAS = @GC_E   )   " EN
                                                ON E~VBELN = A~VBELN
                                               AND E~POSNR = '000000'
   WHERE A~VBELN = @LV_VBELN
    INTO @DATA(LS_ADRC2).

  " Header
  LS_HEAD-NAME1     = LS_ADRC-NAME1.
  LS_HEAD-STREET    = LS_ADRC-STREET && | | && LS_ADRC-STR_SUPPL1.
  LS_HEAD-CITY      = LS_ADRC-CITY1 && | | && LS_ADRC-POST_CODE1.
  LS_HEAD-NAME2     = LS_ADRC2-NAME1 && | | && LS_ADRC2-NAME2.
  LS_HEAD-STREET2   = LS_ADRC2-STREET && | | && LS_ADRC2-CITY1 && | | && LS_ADRC2-POST_CODE1.
  LS_HEAD-DATE      = LS_ADRC2-VDATU+(4) && '.' && LS_ADRC2-VDATU+4(2) && '.' && LS_ADRC2-VDATU+6(2).
  LS_HEAD-ZTERM_TXT = LS_ADRC2-VTEXT.
  LS_HEAD-INCO1     = LS_ADRC2-INCO1.
  LS_HEAD-INCO2     = LS_ADRC2-INCO2.
  LS_HEAD-WAERK     = LS_ADRC2-WAERK.
  LV_NUM = LS_ADRC2-KURRF.
  WRITE LV_NUM TO LS_HEAD-KURRF.

  MOVE LS_HEAD TO GS_EXCEL_HEAD.

  CONDENSE : LS_HEAD-KURRF,
             LS_HEAD-NAME1,
             LS_HEAD-NAME2,
             LS_HEAD-INCO1,
             LS_HEAD-INCO2,
             LS_HEAD-WAERK.

  " ITEM DATA
  SELECT DISTINCT A~VBELN, A~KWMENG AS FKIMG,
         A~KZWI1, A~VRKME, A~MVGR1,
         B~ERDAT, B~WAERK,
         E~NATIO,
         F~NAME,
         G~KBETR, G~WAERS,
         H~BEZEI
    FROM VBAP AS A
    JOIN VBAK AS B  ON B~VBELN = A~VBELN
    LEFT JOIN VBPA AS C  ON C~VBELN = B~VBELN
                        AND C~POSNR = '000000'
                        AND C~PARVW = 'AG'
    LEFT JOIN ( ADRC AS D JOIN T005T AS E  ON E~LAND1 = D~COUNTRY
                                          AND E~SPRAS = '3' )       " KO
                                           ON D~ADDRNUMBER = C~ADRNR
    LEFT JOIN ( MARA AS MA JOIN ZMMT0002 AS F  ON F~ZZCATYPE = MA~ZZCATYPE )
                                               ON MA~MATNR = A~MATNR
    LEFT JOIN PRCD_ELEMENTS AS G  ON G~KNUMV = B~KNUMV
                                 AND G~KPOSN = A~POSNR
                                 AND G~KSCHL = 'ZPR2'
    LEFT JOIN TVM1T AS H  ON H~MVGR1 = A~MVGR1
                         AND H~SPRAS = '3'
   WHERE A~VBELN = @LV_VBELN
    ORDER BY A~VBELN, E~NATIO, F~NAME
    INTO TABLE @DATA(LT_VBRP).

  SELECT SINGLE
         SUM( KWMENG ) AS FKIMG2,
         SUM( KZWI1 ) AS KZWI12
    FROM VBAP
   WHERE VBELN = @LV_VBELN
    INTO @DATA(LS_SUM).

  " Item
  LOOP AT LT_VBRP INTO DATA(LS_VBRP).
    LS_ITEM-VBELN      = LS_VBRP-VBELN.
    LS_ITEM-NATIO      = LS_VBRP-NATIO.
    LS_ITEM-NAME       = LS_VBRP-NAME.
    LS_ITEM-TEXT       = TEXT-T08.

    " 금액 external 변환
    CALL METHOD ZCL_SD_UTIL=>CONV_CURR
      EXPORTING
        I_IN       = ' '
        I_CURRENCY = LS_VBRP-WAERK
        I_AMOUNT   = LS_VBRP-KZWI1
      IMPORTING
        E_AMOUNT   = LS_VBRP-KZWI1.

    " 금액 external 변환
    CALL METHOD ZCL_SD_UTIL=>CONV_CURR
      EXPORTING
        I_IN       = ' '
        I_CURRENCY = LS_VBRP-WAERK
        I_AMOUNT   = LS_SUM-KZWI12
      IMPORTING
        E_AMOUNT   = LS_SUM-KZWI12.

    WRITE LS_VBRP-FKIMG  TO LS_ITEM-FKIMG UNIT LS_VBRP-VRKME.
    WRITE LS_VBRP-KBETR  TO LS_ITEM-KBETR UNIT LS_VBRP-WAERK.
    WRITE LS_VBRP-KZWI1  TO LS_ITEM-KZWI1 UNIT LS_VBRP-WAERK.

    WRITE LS_SUM-FKIMG2  TO LS_ITEM-FKIMG2 UNIT LS_VBRP-VRKME.
    WRITE LS_SUM-KZWI12  TO LS_ITEM-KZWI12 UNIT LS_VBRP-WAERK.

    " 원화금액
    LV_NETPR = LS_VBRP-KZWI1 * LS_ADRC2-KURRF.
    WRITE LV_NETPR TO LS_ITEM-PRICE.

    " 총 원화금액
    LV_NETPR2 = LS_SUM-KZWI12 * LS_ADRC2-KURRF.
    WRITE LV_NETPR2 TO LS_ITEM-PRICE2.

    LS_ITEM-CURRENCY   = LS_VBRP-WAERS.
    LS_ITEM-MVGR1      = LS_VBRP-MVGR1.
    APPEND LS_ITEM TO GT_EXCEL_ITEM.

    IF LV_MVGR1 <> LS_VBRP-MVGR1.
      LV_MVGR1 = LS_VBRP-MVGR1.
      LV_COUNT = 0.
    ENDIF.

    CONDENSE : LS_ITEM-VBELN,
               LS_ITEM-NATIO,
               LS_ITEM-NAME,
               LS_ITEM-TEXT,
               LS_ITEM-FKIMG,
               LS_ITEM-KBETR,
               LS_ITEM-FKIMG2,
               LS_ITEM-KZWI1,
               LS_ITEM-KZWI12,
               LS_ITEM-PRICE,
               LS_ITEM-PRICE2,
               LS_ITEM-MVGR1,
               LS_ITEM-CURRENCY.

    CLEAR : LS_VBRP, LS_ITEM.
  ENDLOOP.

  " Excel Down
  DATA(LV_TXT) = TEXT-T09 && '_' && SY-DATUM.
  PERFORM EXCEL_DOWN USING 'ZSDR0080_INVOICE' LV_TXT
                     CHANGING LV_SUBRC.

  IF LV_SUBRC EQ 0.
** 저장된 엑셀 OPEN                                     &nbs
    CLEAR:G_EXCEL, G_MAPL, G_MAPL, G_SHEET.
    IF G_EXCEL-HEADER = SPACE OR G_EXCEL-HANDLE = -1.
      CREATE OBJECT G_EXCEL 'Excel.Application'.
      PERFORM ERR_HDL.
    ENDIF.

** 엑셀 불러오기                                       &
    CALL METHOD OF G_EXCEL 'Workbooks' = G_MAPL.

    PERFORM ERR_HDL.

    CALL METHOD OF G_MAPL 'OPEN' "= G_MAP
      EXPORTING
        #1 = GV_FILENAME.     "저장된 엑셀 파일명

    CALL METHOD OF G_EXCEL 'Worksheets' = G_SHEET
      EXPORTING
      #1 = 1.

    CALL METHOD OF G_SHEET 'Activate'.

* __엑셀 화면 출력 visible 처리                                  &nb
    SET PROPERTY OF G_EXCEL 'Visible' = 1.           "0-숨김, 1-보이기

    PERFORM FILL_SPREADSHEET_CELL.
  ENDIF.

ENDFORM.
*&---------------------------------------------------------------------*                              &nb
*& Form excel_down                                      
*&---------------------------------------------------------------------*                              &nb
*& text                                        &nb
*&---------------------------------------------------------------------*                              &nb
*&      --> P_                                  
*&---------------------------------------------------------------------*                              &nb
FORM EXCEL_DOWN     USING  PV_OBJID PV_FNAME
                 CHANGING  PV_SUBRC.

  DATA : LV_FNAME  LIKE RLGRAP-FILENAME,
         LV_SUBRC  TYPE SY-SUBRC,
         LV_RETURN TYPE I.

  DATA : LV_DOCUMENT TYPE STRING.
  DATA : LV_DEF      TYPE RLGRAP-FILENAME.
  DATA : LS_KEY      LIKE WWWDATATAB.

  DATA: LV_TIME(22).
  DATA: LT_DOC_TABLE     LIKE W3MIME OCCURS 0,
        L_DOC_SIZE       TYPE I,
        L_DOC_TYPE(80)   VALUE SOI_DOCTYPE_EXCEL_SHEET,
        L_DOC_FORMAT(80) TYPE C.

  DATA: LS_FILE_LENGTH(20), "TYPE I,
        LS_FILENAME      TYPE STRING.

  CLEAR:LT_DOC_TABLE,LT_DOC_TABLE[], GV_FILENAME.

  LV_FNAME = PV_FNAME.

*.. 파일선택창                                        &
  CALL FUNCTION 'WS_FILENAME_GET'
    EXPORTING
      DEF_FILENAME     = LV_FNAME   " 화일명
      MODE             = GC_S
      TITLE            = 'FILE PATH'
    IMPORTING
      FILENAME         = LV_FNAME
    EXCEPTIONS
      INV_WINSYS       = 01
      NO_BATCH         = 02
      SELECTION_CANCEL = 03
      SELECTION_ERROR  = 04.

  PV_SUBRC = SY-SUBRC.

  IF SY-SUBRC  NE 0.
    EXIT.
  ENDIF.

  CALL FUNCTION 'WS_FILE_DELETE'
    EXPORTING
      FILE   = LV_FNAME
    IMPORTING
      RETURN = LV_RETURN.

**  IF LS_RETURN = 0 OR LS_RETURN = 1.                            &nbs
**  ELSE.                                       &n
**    MESSAGE I001 with text-m01.                               &
**    EXIT.                                     &n
**  ENDIF.                                       &

  GV_FILENAME = LV_FNAME.

*..파일이름을 프로그램명으로 넣음                                     &nbs
  LV_DEF = LV_FNAME && '.XLSX'.

  CLEAR: LS_KEY.
  SELECT SINGLE * FROM WWWDATA
  INTO CORRESPONDING FIELDS OF LS_KEY
  WHERE OBJID = PV_OBJID.

  CALL FUNCTION 'DOWNLOAD_WEB_OBJECT'
    EXPORTING
      KEY         = LS_KEY
      DESTINATION = LV_DEF
    IMPORTING
      RC          = LV_SUBRC.

  PV_SUBRC = LV_SUBRC.

  IF LV_SUBRC NE 0.
    EXIT.
  ENDIF.

ENDFORM.
*&---------------------------------------------------------------------*                              &nb
*& Form err_hdl                                      &n
*&---------------------------------------------------------------------*                              &nb
*& text                                        &nb
*&---------------------------------------------------------------------*                              &nb
*& -->  p1        text                             &
*& <--  p2        text                             &
*&---------------------------------------------------------------------*                              &nb
FORM ERR_HDL .

  IF SY-SUBRC <> 0.
    WRITE: / 'Fehler bei OLE-Automation:'(010), SY-SUBRC.
*    STOP.                                     &nb
    EXIT.
  ENDIF.

ENDFORM.
*&---------------------------------------------------------------------*                              &nb
*& Form FILL_SPREADSHEET_CELL                                    
*&---------------------------------------------------------------------*                              &nb
*& text                                        &nb
*&---------------------------------------------------------------------*                              &nb
*& -->  p1        text                             &
*& <--  p2        text                             &
*&---------------------------------------------------------------------*                              &nb
FORM FILL_SPREADSHEET_CELL .

  DATA: LV_LINE_CNT TYPE NUMC10,
        LS_BOLD     TYPE I.

  DATA: LV_VBLEN      TYPE VBELN,
        LV_LFIMG      TYPE LFIMG,
        LV_NTGEW      TYPE NTGEW,
        LV_REMARK     TYPE CHAR200,
        LV_CHAR_QTY   TYPE CHAR20,
        LV_CHAR_NTGEW TYPE CHAR20.
*                                          &n
*  DATA : LV_KRW(13),                                   &nbs
*         LV_AMT(13).                               &nb

  DATA:
    LO_CONTROL     TYPE REF TO I_OI_CONTAINER_CONTROL,
    LO_DOC_PROXY   TYPE REF TO I_OI_DOCUMENT_PROXY,
    LO_SPREADSHEET TYPE REF TO I_OI_SPREADSHEET,
    LT_RANGES      TYPE SOI_FULL_RANGE_TABLE,
    LS_RANGES      LIKE LINE OF LT_RANGES,
    LV_ERROR       TYPE REF TO I_OI_ERROR,
    LV_RET         TYPE SOI_RET_STRING,
    LS_ROW         TYPE OLE2_OBJECT,
    LS_CELL1       TYPE OLE2_OBJECT,
    LS_CELL2       TYPE OLE2_OBJECT,
    LS_CELLS       TYPE OLE2_OBJECT.

  " 통합 INVOICE HEADER
  PERFORM PRO_FILL_CELL_DATA USING: 3 1 1 GS_EXCEL_HEAD-NAME1,
                                    4   1   0  GS_EXCEL_HEAD-STREET,
                                    5   1   0  GS_EXCEL_HEAD-CITY,
                                    8   1   1  GS_EXCEL_HEAD-NAME2,
                                    9   1   0  GS_EXCEL_HEAD-STREET2,
                                    3   10  0  GS_EXCEL_HEAD-DATE,
                                    5   6   0  GS_EXCEL_HEAD-ZTERM_TXT,
                                    10  7   0  GS_EXCEL_HEAD-INCO1,
                                    10  8   0  GS_EXCEL_HEAD-INCO2,
                                    12  8   0  GS_EXCEL_HEAD-KURRF,
                                    13  8   0  GS_EXCEL_HEAD-KURRF.

  LV_LINE_CNT = 19.

  " 라인 삽입
  DATA(LV_LINES) = LINES( GT_EXCEL_ITEM ).
*  LV_LINES += 19.                                    &
*  DATA(LV_LINE)  = '20:' && LV_LINES.                              &n

  GV_LINE = LV_LINES + 20.

  DATA(LV_TIMES) = LV_LINES - 1.

  DO LV_TIMES TIMES.
    CALL METHOD OF G_EXCEL 'Rows' = LS_ROW
    EXPORTING
      #1       = 20. "- 복사될 위치 (복수가능-->3:4)

    CALL METHOD OF LS_ROW 'Select'.  "- Row선택.
    CALL METHOD OF LS_ROW 'Insert'.  "- Row추가.
  ENDDO.


  LOOP AT GT_EXCEL_ITEM INTO DATA(LS_ITEM).

    LV_LINE_CNT = LV_LINE_CNT + 1.

    LS_ITEM-VBELN = |{ LS_ITEM-VBELN ALPHA = OUT }|.

    PERFORM PRO_FILL_CELL_DATA USING:
          LV_LINE_CNT  1  0   LS_ITEM-VBELN,
          LV_LINE_CNT  2  0   LS_ITEM-NATIO,
          LV_LINE_CNT  3  0   LS_ITEM-NAME,
          LV_LINE_CNT  4  0   LS_ITEM-TEXT,
          LV_LINE_CNT  5  0   LS_ITEM-FKIMG,
          LV_LINE_CNT  6  0   LS_ITEM-KBETR,
          LV_LINE_CNT  7  0   LS_ITEM-KZWI1,
          LV_LINE_CNT  8  0   LS_ITEM-FKIMG,
          LV_LINE_CNT  9  0   LS_ITEM-KZWI1,
          LV_LINE_CNT 10  0   LS_ITEM-PRICE.

    " 앞쪽에 통화 보이게 하기
    PERFORM SET_CURRENCY USING :
          LV_LINE_CNT 6  LS_ITEM-KBETR LS_ITEM-CURRENCY,
          LV_LINE_CNT 7  LS_ITEM-KZWI1 LS_ITEM-CURRENCY,
          LV_LINE_CNT 9  LS_ITEM-KZWI1 LS_ITEM-CURRENCY,
          LV_LINE_CNT 10 LS_ITEM-PRICE 'KRW'.

    CLEAR: LS_ITEM, LV_CHAR_QTY, LV_CHAR_NTGEW.
  ENDLOOP.

  ADD 1 TO LV_LINE_CNT.
  READ TABLE GT_EXCEL_ITEM INTO LS_ITEM WITH KEY CURRENCY = 'EUR'.
  IF SY-SUBRC EQ 0.
    DATA(LV_EUR) = LS_ITEM-KZWI12.
  ENDIF.

  READ TABLE GT_EXCEL_ITEM INTO LS_ITEM WITH KEY CURRENCY = 'USD'.
  IF SY-SUBRC EQ 0.
    DATA(LV_USD) = LS_ITEM-KZWI12.
  ENDIF.

  PERFORM PRO_FILL_CELL_DATA USING: LV_LINE_CNT 7 0 LV_EUR,
                                    LV_LINE_CNT  8  0  LS_ITEM-FKIMG2,
                                    LV_LINE_CNT  9  0  LV_EUR,
                                    LV_LINE_CNT  10 0  LS_ITEM-PRICE.

  ADD 1 TO LV_LINE_CNT.
  PERFORM PRO_FILL_CELL_DATA USING: LV_LINE_CNT 7 0 LV_USD,
                                    LV_LINE_CNT  9  0  LV_USD.


  PERFORM SET_COLOR USING LV_LINES.

  " 시트 이동해서 데이터 채우기
  CLEAR : LS_ITEM.

  DATA(LV_CNT) = 1.

  CLEAR : LV_EUR, LV_USD.
  DO 4 TIMES.
    LV_LINE_CNT = 19.
    LV_CNT += 1.

    CALL METHOD OF G_EXCEL 'WORKSHEETS' = G_SHEET
       EXPORTING
         #1       = LV_CNT.

    CALL METHOD OF G_SHEET 'Activate'.

    PERFORM PRO_FILL_CELL_DATA USING: 3 1 0 GS_EXCEL_HEAD-NAME1,
                                      4   1   0  GS_EXCEL_HEAD-STREET,
                                      5   1   0  GS_EXCEL_HEAD-CITY,
                                      8   1   0  GS_EXCEL_HEAD-NAME2,
                                      9   1   0  GS_EXCEL_HEAD-STREET2,
                                      3   10  0  GS_EXCEL_HEAD-DATE,
                                      5   6   0  GS_EXCEL_HEAD-ZTERM_TXT,
                                      10  7   0  GS_EXCEL_HEAD-INCO1,
                                      10  8   0  GS_EXCEL_HEAD-INCO2,
                                      12  8   0  GS_EXCEL_HEAD-KURRF,
                                      13  8   0  GS_EXCEL_HEAD-KURRF.


    " 공장 순서대로 시트 이동하면서 데이터 채울 예정이라 ( 서산->소하리->화성->광주 순 )
    " 시트 변경시엔 로직 수정해야 할 예정
    CASE LV_CNT.
      WHEN 2.
        DATA(LV_MVGR1) = 'K01'.
      WHEN 3.
        LV_MVGR1 = 'K02'.
      WHEN 4.
        LV_MVGR1 = 'K03'.
      WHEN 5.
        LV_MVGR1 = 'K04'.
    ENDCASE.

    DATA(LT_MVGR1) = GT_EXCEL_ITEM.
    DELETE LT_MVGR1 WHERE MVGR1 <> LV_MVGR1.
    LV_LINES = LINES( LT_MVGR1 ).
    LV_TIMES = LV_LINES - 1.

    DO LV_TIMES TIMES.
      CALL METHOD OF G_EXCEL 'Rows' = LS_ROW
      EXPORTING
        #1       = 20. "- 복사될 위치 (복수가능-->3:4)

      CALL METHOD OF LS_ROW 'Select'.  "- Row선택.
      CALL METHOD OF LS_ROW 'Insert'.  "- Row추가.
    ENDDO.

    DATA(LV_LINE) = LINES( LT_MVGR1 ).

    LOOP AT GT_EXCEL_ITEM INTO LS_ITEM WHERE MVGR1 = LV_MVGR1.
      LV_LINE_CNT = LV_LINE_CNT + 1.

      LS_ITEM-VBELN = |{ LS_ITEM-VBELN ALPHA = OUT }|.

      PERFORM PRO_FILL_CELL_DATA USING:
            LV_LINE_CNT  1  0   LS_ITEM-VBELN,
            LV_LINE_CNT  2  0   LS_ITEM-NATIO,
            LV_LINE_CNT  3  0   LS_ITEM-NAME,
            LV_LINE_CNT  4  0   LS_ITEM-TEXT,
            LV_LINE_CNT  5  0   LS_ITEM-FKIMG,
            LV_LINE_CNT  6  0   LS_ITEM-KBETR,
            LV_LINE_CNT  7  0   LS_ITEM-KZWI1,
            LV_LINE_CNT  8  0   LS_ITEM-FKIMG,
            LV_LINE_CNT  9  0   LS_ITEM-KZWI1,
            LV_LINE_CNT 10  0   LS_ITEM-PRICE.

      PERFORM SET_CURRENCY USING :
          LV_LINE_CNT 6  LS_ITEM-KBETR LS_ITEM-CURRENCY,
          LV_LINE_CNT 7  LS_ITEM-KZWI1 LS_ITEM-CURRENCY,
          LV_LINE_CNT 9  LS_ITEM-KZWI1 LS_ITEM-CURRENCY.
*          LV_LINE_CNT 10 LS_ITEM-PRICE 'KRW'.                        

      CLEAR: LS_ITEM, LV_CHAR_QTY, LV_CHAR_NTGEW.
    ENDLOOP.

    DATA(LV_TEMP_CNT) = LV_LINE_CNT.

    ADD 1 TO LV_LINE_CNT.

    READ TABLE GT_EXCEL_ITEM INTO LS_ITEM WITH KEY CURRENCY = 'USD'.
    IF SY-SUBRC EQ 0.
      LV_USD = LS_ITEM-FKIMG2.
    ENDIF.
    CASE GS_EXCEL_HEAD-WAERK.
      WHEN 'EUR'.
        DATA(LV_EUR2) = '=SUM(G20:G' && LV_TEMP_CNT.
      WHEN 'USD'.
        DATA(LV_USD2) = '=SUM(G20:G' && LV_TEMP_CNT.
    ENDCASE.

    DATA(LV_AMT2) = '=SUM(H20:H' && LV_TEMP_CNT.
    DATA(LV_KRW2) = '=SUM(J20:J' && LV_TEMP_CNT.

    PERFORM PRO_FILL_CELL_DATA USING: LV_LINE_CNT 7 0 LV_EUR2,
                                      LV_LINE_CNT  8  0  LV_AMT2,
                                      LV_LINE_CNT  9  0  LV_EUR2,
                                      LV_LINE_CNT  10 0  LV_KRW2.

    ADD 1 TO LV_LINE_CNT.
    PERFORM PRO_FILL_CELL_DATA USING: LV_LINE_CNT 7 0 LV_USD2,
                                      LV_LINE_CNT  9  0  LV_USD2.

    PERFORM SET_COLOR USING LV_LINES.

    CLEAR : LS_ITEM, LV_EUR, LV_USD, LV_EUR2, LV_USD2, LV_KRW2, LV_AMT2.
  ENDDO.

  CALL METHOD OF G_EXCEL 'ActiveWorkbook' = G_AWORK.
  CALL METHOD OF G_AWORK 'Save'.


ENDFORM.
*&---------------------------------------------------------------------*                              &nb
*& Form PRO_FILL_CELL_DATA                                    &nb
*&---------------------------------------------------------------------*                              &nb
*& text                                        &nb
*&---------------------------------------------------------------------*                              &nb
*&      --> P_3                                 &nbs
*&      --> P_1                                 &nbs
*&      --> P_0                                 &nbs
*&      --> GS_EXCEL_HEAD_NAME1                               
*&---------------------------------------------------------------------*                              &nb
FORM PRO_FILL_CELL_DATA  USING I J BOLD VAL.

  CALL METHOD OF G_EXCEL 'Cells' = G_ZL
    EXPORTING
    #1 = I      "행
    #2 = J.     "열

*    perform err_hdl.                                   
  SET PROPERTY OF G_ZL 'Value' = VAL.
*    perform err_hdl.                                   
  GET PROPERTY OF G_ZL 'Font'  = G_F.
*    perform err_hdl.                                   
  SET PROPERTY OF G_F  'Bold'  = BOLD.
*    perform err_hdl.                                   


ENDFORM.
*&---------------------------------------------------------------------*                              &nb
*& Form SET_COLOR                                      
*&---------------------------------------------------------------------*                              &nb
*& text                                        &nb
*&---------------------------------------------------------------------*                              &nb
*&      --> LS_ROW                                 &
*&---------------------------------------------------------------------*                              &nb
FORM SET_COLOR USING PV_LINES.

  DATA: LV_RANGE TYPE CHAR30,
        LV_CNT   TYPE NUMC10.
  DATA: LV_HINTERIOR TYPE OLE2_OBJECT,
        LS_ROW       TYPE OLE2_OBJECT,
        LS_CELL      TYPE OLE_OBJECT,
        LS_FONT      TYPE OLE2_OBJECT.

  LV_CNT = 19.

  DO PV_LINES TIMES.
    LV_CNT += 1.

    CALL METHOD OF G_EXCEL 'Rows' = LS_ROW
    EXPORTING
      #1       = LV_CNT.

    CALL METHOD OF LS_ROW 'Interior' = LV_HINTERIOR.
    SET PROPERTY OF LV_HINTERIOR 'ColorIndex' = 2.   "white

    " FONT
    GET PROPERTY OF LS_ROW  'Font' = LS_FONT.
    SET PROPERTY OF LS_FONT 'Name' = TEXT-M07.

    FREE OBJECT: LV_HINTERIOR, LS_ROW.
  ENDDO.


ENDFORM.
*&---------------------------------------------------------------------*                              &nb
*& Form SET_CURRENCY                                     &nb
*&---------------------------------------------------------------------*                              &nb
*& text                                        &nb
*&---------------------------------------------------------------------*                              &nb
*&      --> LV_LINE_CNT                                &n
*&      --> P_6                                 &nbs
*&      --> LS_ITEM_KBETR                                
*&      --> LS_ITEM_CURENCY                               &nbs
*&---------------------------------------------------------------------*                              &nb
FORM SET_CURRENCY  USING    PV_COL
                            PV_ROW
                            PV_VAL
                            PV_CURRENCY.

  DATA : NUMBERFORMAT TYPE STRING. " VALUE '@ #,##0.00'.
  CLEAR : NUMBERFORMAT.

  CASE PV_CURRENCY.
    WHEN 'EUR'.
      NUMBERFORMAT = '_([$#-x-euro2] * #,##0.00_);_([$#-x-euro2] * (#,##0.00);_([$#-x-euro2] * \"\"-\"\"??_);_(@_)'.
    WHEN 'USD'.
      NUMBERFORMAT = '_([$$-en-US]* #,##0.00_);_([$$-en-US]* (#,##0.00);_([$$-en-US]* \"\"-\"\"??_);_(@_)'.
    WHEN 'KRW'.
      NUMBERFORMAT = '|#,##0_);[빨강](\#,##0)'.
  ENDCASE.

*  REPLACE '@' INTO NUMBERFORMAT WITH PV_CURRENCY(3).                            

  CALL METHOD OF G_EXCEL 'Cells' = G_ZL
      EXPORTING
      #1 = PV_COL      "행
      #2 = PV_ROW.     "열

  PERFORM ERR_HDL.

  SET PROPERTY OF G_ZL 'Style' = 'currency'.
  PERFORM ERR_HDL.

  IF NUMBERFORMAT IS NOT INITIAL.
    SET PROPERTY OF G_ZL 'NumberFormat' = NUMBERFORMAT.
    PERFORM ERR_HDL.
  ENDIF.

  CLEAR : NUMBERFORMAT.

ENDFORM.
*&---------------------------------------------------------------------*                              &nb
*& Form VIN                                       
*&---------------------------------------------------------------------*                              &nb
*& text                                        &nb
*&---------------------------------------------------------------------*                              &nb
*& -->  p1        text                             &
*& <--  p2        text                             &
*&---------------------------------------------------------------------*                              &nb
FORM VIN .

  DATA : LV_SUBRC TYPE SY-SUBRC.

  DATA: LV_LINE_CNT TYPE NUMC10,
        LV_CNT      TYPE NUMC10,
        LS_BOLD     TYPE I.

  DATA : LS_DATA2 TYPE TY_DATA2,
         LT_ROWS  TYPE LVC_T_ROID.

  CLEAR : LS_DATA2.
  MODIFY GT_DATA2 FROM LS_DATA2 TRANSPORTING CHK WHERE CHK IS NOT INITIAL.

  PERFORM SELECTED_ROWS(ZSDR0000) TABLES LT_ROWS
                                   USING GO_GRID2.

  " 선택한 라인이 없으면 에러
  IF LT_ROWS IS INITIAL.
    MESSAGE I004.
    EXIT.
  ENDIF.

  " 선택 라인 체크
  LOOP AT LT_ROWS INTO DATA(LS_ROWS).
    READ TABLE GT_DATA2 ASSIGNING FIELD-SYMBOL(<FS>) INDEX LS_ROWS-ROW_ID.
    IF <FS> IS ASSIGNED.

      <FS>-CHK = ABAP_TRUE.

      UNASSIGN <FS>.
    ENDIF.
  ENDLOOP.

  DATA(LT_DATA) = GT_DATA2.
  DELETE LT_DATA WHERE CHK IS INITIAL.

  " 판매오더 있는 건만
  READ TABLE LT_DATA INTO DATA(LS_DATA) WITH KEY CHK   = ABAP_TRUE
                                                 VGBEL = ''.
  IF SY-SUBRC EQ 0.
    MESSAGE I000 WITH TEXT-E06.
    EXIT.
  ENDIF.

  " 판매오더 2건 이상 선택됐는지 확인
  DATA(LT_VBELN) = GT_DATA2.
  DELETE LT_VBELN WHERE CHK IS INITIAL.
  SORT LT_VBELN BY VBELN.
  DELETE ADJACENT DUPLICATES FROM LT_VBELN COMPARING VGBEL.

  IF LINES( LT_VBELN ) > 1.
    MESSAGE I000 WITH TEXT-E08.
    EXIT.
  ENDIF.

  " VIN 정보 있는지 확인
  DATA(LT_VIN_CHK) = GT_DATA2.
  DELETE LT_VIN_CHK WHERE CHK IS INITIAL.
  IF C_03 EQ ABAP_TRUE.
    READ TABLE LT_VIN_CHK INTO DATA(LS_VIN_CHK) WITH KEY FULL_VIN_NO = ''.
    IF SY-SUBRC EQ 0.
      MESSAGE TEXT-E16 TYPE GC_I.
      EXIT.
    ENDIF.

  ELSE.
    READ TABLE LT_VIN_CHK INTO LS_VIN_CHK WITH KEY PVINNO = 0.
    IF SY-SUBRC EQ 0.
      MESSAGE TEXT-E16 TYPE GC_I.
      EXIT.
    ENDIF.
  ENDIF.

  WITH +MAIN AS (
  SELECT DISTINCT
         A~VBELN, A~POSNR,
         B~NO_LINE_D, B~VIN_NO,
         D~BSTKD_E,
         F~WAERK,
         G~NAME,
         I~NATIO
    FROM @LT_DATA AS A
    JOIN ZSDT0180 AS B  ON B~WORDER_NO = A~BSTKD_E
    JOIN ZSDT0200 AS C  ON C~NO_PDI  = B~NO_PDI
                       AND C~NO_LINE = B~NO_LINE
                       AND C~VBELN   = A~VGBEL
                       AND C~POSNR   = A~VGPOS
    LEFT JOIN VBKD AS D  ON D~BSTKD_E = A~BSTKD_E
    JOIN VBAP AS E  ON E~VBELN = A~VGBEL
                   AND E~POSNR = A~VGPOS
    JOIN VBAK AS F  ON F~VBELN = E~VBELN
    LEFT JOIN ( MARA AS MA JOIN ZMMT0002 AS G  ON G~ZZCATYPE = MA~ZZCATYPE )
                                               ON MA~MATNR = E~MATNR
    LEFT JOIN VBPA AS H  ON H~VBELN = F~VBELN
                        AND H~POSNR = '000000'
                        AND H~PARVW = 'AG'
    LEFT JOIN ( ADRC AS AD JOIN T005T AS I  ON I~LAND1 = AD~COUNTRY
                                           AND I~SPRAS = 'E' )       " EN
                                            ON AD~ADDRNUMBER = H~ADRNR
   GROUP BY A~VBELN, A~POSNR, B~NO_LINE_D, D~BSTKD_E, B~VIN_NO, I~NATIO, G~NAME, F~WAERK
   ORDER BY B~NO_LINE_D, D~BSTKD_E, B~VIN_NO     ),

  +PRICE_RAW AS (
  SELECT DISTINCT A~BSTKD_E,
         B~KZWI1
    FROM +MAIN AS A
    JOIN VBRP AS B  ON B~AUBEL = A~VBELN
                   AND B~AUPOS = A~POSNR
    JOIN VBRK AS C  ON C~VBELN = B~VBELN
                   AND C~FKSTO IS INITIAL
                   AND C~SFAKN IS INITIAL   ),

  +PRICE AS (
  SELECT DISTINCT BSTKD_E,
         SUM( KZWI1 ) AS KZWI1
    FROM +PRICE_RAW
   GROUP BY BSTKD_E     )

  SELECT DISTINCT A~NO_LINE_D, A~VIN_NO,
         A~BSTKD_E, A~WAERK, A~NAME,
         A~NATIO,
         B~KZWI1
    FROM +MAIN AS A
    JOIN +PRICE AS B  ON B~BSTKD_E = A~BSTKD_E
    INTO TABLE @DATA(LT_VIN).


  " 통화대로 엑셀 생성해야 해서
  DATA(LT_CURRENCY) = LT_VIN.
  SORT LT_CURRENCY BY WAERK.
  DELETE ADJACENT DUPLICATES FROM LT_CURRENCY COMPARING WAERK.

  LOOP AT LT_CURRENCY INTO DATA(LS_CURRENCY).
    " Excel Down
    DATA(LV_TXT) = TEXT-T10 && '_' && SY-DATUM.
    PERFORM EXCEL_DOWN USING 'ZSDR0080_VIN' LV_TXT
                        CHANGING LV_SUBRC.

    IF LV_SUBRC EQ 0.
** 저장된 엑셀 OPEN                                     &nbs
      CLEAR:G_EXCEL,G_MAPL,G_MAPL.
      IF G_EXCEL-HEADER = SPACE OR G_EXCEL-HANDLE = -1.
        CREATE OBJECT G_EXCEL 'Excel.Application'.
        PERFORM ERR_HDL.
      ENDIF.

** 엑셀 불러오기                                       &
      CALL METHOD OF G_EXCEL 'Workbooks' = G_MAPL.

      PERFORM ERR_HDL.

      CALL METHOD OF G_MAPL 'OPEN' "= G_MAP
        EXPORTING
          #1 = GV_FILENAME.     "저장된 엑셀 파일명

      CALL METHOD OF G_EXCEL 'Worksheets' = G_SHEET
        EXPORTING
        #1 = 1.

      CALL METHOD OF G_SHEET 'Activate'.

* __엑셀 화면 출력 visible 처리                                  &nb
      SET PROPERTY OF G_EXCEL 'Visible' = 1.           "0-숨김, 1-보이기

      " 헤더 셀 이름 채워넣기
      DATA(LV_PRICE_TXT) = '금액(@)'.

      CASE LS_CURRENCY-WAERK.
        WHEN 'EUR'.
          DATA(LV_CURR) = 'EUR#'.
        WHEN 'USD'.
          LV_CURR = 'US$'.
        WHEN 'KRW'.
          LV_CURR = 'KRW'.
      ENDCASE.

      REPLACE '@' INTO LV_PRICE_TXT WITH LV_CURR.

      PERFORM PRO_FILL_CELL_DATA USING:
                  1   7   1 LV_PRICE_TXT,
                  1   9   1 LV_CURR.

      DATA(LT_VIN_COUNT) = LT_VIN.
      DELETE LT_VIN_COUNT WHERE WAERK <> LS_CURRENCY-WAERK.
      DATA(LV_LINE)   = LINES( LT_VIN_COUNT ).
      DATA(LV_COUNT)  = '=COUNTA(G2:G' && LV_LINE && ')'.
      DATA(LV_COUNT2) = '=COUNTA(P2:P' && LV_LINE && ')'.

      PERFORM PRO_FILL_CELL_DATA USING:
                  4   9   0   LV_COUNT,
                  4   10  0   LV_COUNT2.

      " 데이터 채워넣기
      LV_LINE_CNT = 1.

      LOOP AT LT_VIN INTO DATA(LS_VIN) WHERE WAERK = LS_CURRENCY-WAERK.

        LV_LINE_CNT += 1.
        LV_CNT      += 1.

        DATA(LV_WORDER) = '=LEFT(L' && LV_LINE_CNT && ',12)'.
        DATA(LV_VIN)    = '=LEFT(M' && LV_LINE_CNT && ',13)'.
